scores.round_files_fidelity_rationale: Flat. Gained: EnumTranslator is a close statement-level port. Translate's four overloads, the -1 default entry, the Private check, Dictionary.Add duplicate-key throws, the Convert.ToInt32 overflow, sorted versus unsorted insertion and GetValue's first-match-else-(-1) all match. EnumToList correctly passes checkPrivate=true, as EnumTranslator.cs:27 does. LTM's NewByte reproduces C#'s quirks exactly: the checksum byte is stored first, the length test is state+1+payload, state is reset twice, and crc^=data and payload++ still run after a completed frame. The G/A/S payloads decode little-endian from offset 3. The member order of the Json.NET-style output (fields, then get-only properties, enum as a number) matches DefaultContractResolver. I checked the recorded stream's first G, A and S checksums by hand (0xAF, 0x5B, 0x6D): all are accepted. R67-04's per-frame gate is gone. RALLY_TOTAL now uses float G7 for REAL32. Lost: (a) enumtranslator.rs:170-171 asserts that EnumToList includes the [Private(true)] member 10, but the code (correctly) hides it, so translate_orders_and_hides fails. The doc comment at line 61 ('private ones included') contradicts both the code and C#. (b) GetDisplayText (115-127) takes the first field with the value, not the field named by ToString(), so for alias members with different [DisplayText] it can pick the wrong attribute. Its parameter is an i64, not a T. (c) OrderBy(x => x.Value) goes through culture_compare, an approximation of NLS word sort (hyphen and apostrophe weights are missing). (d) LTM handlers must be Send, there is no '-=', and the sender argument is dropped. (e) The skip_params connect still loads the param cache and still sends RequestParams for Params_BG (app.rs:592-621). C# guards both with 'getparams && compid != MAV_COMP_ID_PERIPHERAL' (MainV2.cs:1665), and that compid check is missing entirely. (f) With getparams=false, C# still runs the showui firmware Task: it downloads the manifest and calls GetMetaDataVersioned, while VersionString is '' so no prompt appears. Rust arms nothing. (g) The flags are still not cleared on SetTarget (app.rs:919).
scores.ui_ux_rationale: Flat. Fixed: unticking 'Show me again?' no longer closes the new-firmware box. It stays until OK, as Common.MessageShowAgain's form does. The altmode combo and the grid's Frame column now come from EnumToList. They show the same three items as before, in C#'s order, and a grid frame outside the list shows blank, as the DataError path does in C#. Still wrong: CMB_altmode can show blank (flight_plan.rs:994), but in C# it never does. A SelectedValue that is not in the list gives SelectedIndex -1, and CMB_altmode_SelectedIndexChanged (FlightPlanner.cs:2145-2150) then forces index 0 (Relative). processToScreen (flight_plan.rs:1696) ignores a WP frame outside the list instead of falling back to Relative and saving FPaltmode. The prompt title is a bold label, not the caption, and the composed text goes through i18n::t as one string. The title bar still ignores cs.version_string (app.rs:1500-1509). There are still no markers, no ZoomAndCenterMarkers, no rally-distance warning, no geofence download and no GCSView ports.
scores.features_rationale: Up 0.1. With the parameter download skipped, 'Load Waypoints on connect' now runs the WP read on connect, as doConnect does when getparams is false. A later Refresh Params no longer switches view, reads waypoints, fetches rally points or checks firmware, and Disconnected clears the flags. A REAL32 RALLY_TOTAL near an integer now parses as C# does. Still wrong: skip_params still loads the param cache and, with Params_BG, still downloads the parameters (C# does neither). There is no MAV_COMP_ID_PERIPHERAL check. The flags survive a vehicle change (SetTarget). With a fresh cache the link still downloads again, and with Params_BG everything still waits for the download. A stale awaiting_read still blocks the deferred rally fetch, and mission reads have no request id. The geofence download and RALLY_LIMIT_KM warning are missing. Integer parameters of 1e7 or more lose digits (Param.value is f32). FFT output is not fftui's. setWPParams ignores the distance unit. LTM and EnumTranslator add no user-visible feature beyond the combo source.

compile_check.summary: I checked every new and changed region against its definitions. enumtranslator.rs: super::attributes::{displaytextattribute::DisplayTextAttribute, privateattribute::PrivateAttribute} exist (utilities/mod.rs:5, attributes/mod.rs:3-5). Both derive Clone + Debug, so EnumFieldInfo's derive holds. DisplayTextAttribute::text() -> String and PrivateAttribute::is_private() -> bool exist. crate::dotnet::collections::Dictionary has new/contains_key/insert/iter (iter yields (&K, &V)), and dotnet/mod.rs:11 makes collections pub. culture_compare(&str, &str) -> Ordering (mod.rs:204) and Exception::Argument/Overflow (mod.rs:816/830) exist. Dictionary::new() infers <i32, String> from add(). Result<Vec<_>, Exception>::unwrap_or_default needs only Vec: Default. ltm.rs: crate::cs_enum! is #[macro_export] (mod.rs:236). Its pattern '$(#[$m:meta])* $vis $name : $t { .. }' accepts '/// doc pub mode: i32 { .. }'. It emits a pub tuple newtype, so mode(x as i32) and .0 work, along with associated consts (mode::Horizon), Debug and PartialEq for assert_eq!, and #[allow(non_camel_case_types)]. dotnet::json::J has Int/Bool/Obj and to_indented (json.rs:67-107). dotnet::io::console_write_line(&str) exists (io.rs:13). type Handler<T> = Box<dyn FnMut(&T) + Send> is implicitly 'static, and the add_* methods take impl FnMut(&X) + Send + 'static, so Box::new coerces. 'for h in v.iter_mut() { h(&g) }' calls through &mut Box<dyn FnMut>, which is FnMut. 'let line = self.packet;' copies the [u8; 100] (Copy) before the &mut self call, and &[u8; 100] unsizes to &[u8]. In Some(18) etc., the integer is inferred as i32 from state + 1 + payload. static TEST_DATA: &[u8] iterates as &u8. In the tests, the Arc<Mutex<Vec<G>>>/<i32>/<Vec<S>> closures are Send + 'static, and '*a2.lock().unwrap() += 1' is a () expression. mission.rs:74-88: the full path crate::extlibs::utilities::enumtranslator::{EnumReflect, EnumFieldInfo} is public (lib.rs:8, extlibs/mod.rs:12, utilities/mod.rs:13). '*m as i64' / '**m as i64' cast a Copy fieldless enum. flight_plan.rs: the mp_core::extlibs::utilities::enumtranslator path is public, and AltMode is already imported (used at 470). In the combo closures, find(|(k, _)| *k == cur) peels &&(i32, String) through match ergonomics. map(|(_, v)| v.as_str()) borrows list, which outlives selected_text. For (k, v) in &list, k is &i32 and v is &String. ComboBox::show_ui(..).response is a Response, so the closure is a Widget. app.settings.alt_frame / w.frame are mutated through disjoint closure captures, the same pattern as the code they replace. app.rs: Param { value: f32, ptype: u8 } (link.rs:43-46), so p.ptype == 9 is u8 == integer and float_to_string(f32) (mod.rs:680) takes p.value. double_to_string(p.value as f64) and int_parse(&String) -> Result<i32, _> then .ok() / unwrap_or(0) give i32. SharedState::skip_params: bool (link.rs:97) is set at construction (304), before Connected is emitted (1235). params_skipped is declared at 580 inside the Connected arm and used at 581 and 590 in the same arm. self.load_wps_after_params / self.firmware_check_after_params / self.toasts are disjoint from pl (&mut self.settings.planner, still live until 594) and from link (&self.link). drain_events:528 should_show(&BTreeMap, &String -> &str) borrows self.settings immutably before self.firmware_prompt is assigned. App::ui:1492-1495 now only calls p.ui. No definite compile error.

findings.cs_reference: ExtLibs/Utilities/EnumTranslator.cs:25-30 (EnumToList passes checkPrivate=true), 107-123 (GetDisplayText uses GetField(value.ToString())), 92 (OrderBy(x => x.Value), current culture)
findings.summary: New. (1) The unit test asserts that EnumToList includes a [Private(true)] member. The code correctly hides it, as C# does, so the test fails and 'cargo test' is red. The doc comment at line 61 says 'private ones included', which is wrong. (2) GetDisplayText picks the first field whose value matches. The check T::to_cs_string(f.value) == name is always true once f.value == value, so for alias members (two names, one value) with different [DisplayText] it can return the wrong text, where C# uses the field named by Enum.ToString(). It also takes an i64 instead of a T. (3) Sorting uses culture_compare, a partial model of NLS word sort.
findings.required_fix: Fix the test expectation to [(3, Relative), (0, Absolute)] and the doc comment. Make GetDisplayText find the field by the name ToString gives (add the member name to EnumFieldInfo), and make it generic over a T value. Add an alias-member test.

verdict: No definite compile error. The two new ports type-check against their definitions: EnumReflect/EnumFieldInfo, Dictionary, culture_compare, the cs_enum newtype, J, console_write_line, and the Box<dyn FnMut + Send> handlers with array copy before NewLine. The AltMode impl in mission.rs, the egui combo closures, p.ptype (u8) with float_to_string(f32), and params_skipped's scope in the Connected arm also check. The new enumtranslator test fails, though: it expects EnumToList to include a [Private(true)] member, which the code (correctly, as C#) hides. EnumTranslator.cs and LTM.cs are faithful statement-level ports. LTM keeps every quirk of the state machine, and the recorded stream's checksums verify by hand. EnumTranslator is wired into CMB_altmode and the Frame column exactly where FlightPlanner.cs uses it. R67-04's per-frame gate is fixed. R67-05 is partly fixed: the flags are cleared on disconnect, the skip_params WP read works, and REAL32 RALLY_TOTAL uses G7. But the skip_params connect still loads the cache and downloads parameters with Params_BG, there is no PERIPHERAL check, the flags survive SetTarget, and processToScreen does not fall back to Relative as the C# combo does. Ported lines rise to 27,806 / 479,014 (5.8%). The cap stays 1.6. Awarded 1.3; round-file fidelity 6.1; UI/UX 2.4; features 3.4.
